props.prompt: Take the gate to the Great Dump
Follow the drain to the river
Follow the power line into the hills

title: Old Tobi's House
subtitle: it smells of solder and soup

props.title: Tobi's diary
lines: Tobi's handwriting, shaky: 'Things I must not forget.'
'1. Water the beans. 2. The radio needs a valve. 3. Her name was Ines.'
'4. The metro under the yard flooded in the second winter. Something still moves down there.'
'5. I walled up the pantry. If I forget why, it is because I wanted to.'

done_lines: A voice through the static: '...anyone on this band, the river is still moving...'
Then nothing. But somebody is out there.

title: The Tool Shed
subtitle: everything here is broken, or about to be

done_lines: The bulb buzzes on. Behind the workbench hangs a pickaxe.
You take it. Swing it (J) at ore veins to break them.

props.title: a torn notice
lines: A notice, half torn: 'METRO SERVICE STAFF: the maintenance key is kept in the ticket office safe drawer.'
Someone has scrawled under it: 'not any more. it's in the office desk down there. good luck.'

title: The Old Metro
subtitle: the last trains left from here

props.title: a timetable
lines: A timetable. Every train after the 14th is crossed out by hand.
Under the last one, in pencil: 'They said the water would be fine by spring.'

done_lines: Green lamps flicker along the tunnel. A drawer in the signal box springs open:
a blue-tagged key. 'MAINTENANCE ONLY'.

props.locked_text: A service gate. A blue tag on the lock reads: MAINTENANCE KEY.

done_lines: The safe swings open: a welding mask, two crystal cells,
and a photo of a girl with Halden's eyes. On the back: 'for Asha, 14 July'.
You know every symbol on the board now. So would anyone who read it.

props.title: a memo
lines: MEMO: 'Discharge within limits. Limits revised upward, effective immediately.'
Signed by Halden. Underneath, in his hand: 'I should not have signed this.'

title: The Recycling Hall
subtitle: the line still runs, if someone runs it

done_lines: The line rattles to a stop. Neat piles, each in its bin. Nana Ru would approve.
The pickers' board: what goes where. You could teach it now.

props.title: a child's drawing
lines: A crayon drawing: a tall woman with white hair, a boy running, and a big sun.
'NANA RU AND ME AND THE SUN COMING BACK' it says, in letters of every size.

title: Nana Ru's Shack
subtitle: everything has a price, and a use

props.title: Nana Ru's ledger
lines: Columns of trades in tiny writing: 'Six bottles: one tin of beans. One battery, sealed: two days of water.'
On the last page: 'Kip's birthday. Find him something that is not rubbish.'

props.title: Osei's ledger
lines: A ferryman's ledger. Fares, weather, who crossed and when.
A note in the margin: 'Halden came by again. Asked me to keep his safe code, in case he forgets:
his girl's birthday, the 14th of July. 1-4-7. Poor man.'

done_lines: Water rushes through the filters and out of the tap, clear and cold.
Gravel, sand, charcoal, sand. The water that drips out the bottom is clear.

title: Lena's Farmhouse
subtitle: the seeds are still in the drawer

done_lines: The heap warms in your hands. In a week it will be soil. Jory claps, silently, delighted.
Jory's chart, drawn in pictures because he does not speak:
beans feed the soil, corn climbs the beans, squash shades the weeds.

props.title: Jory's drawing
lines: Jory cannot speak, so he draws. This one: the field green, Lena smiling, and you, holding a spade.
It is dated tomorrow.

title: The Old Barn
subtitle: hay, rust and a locked stall

done_lines: The padlock clicks. Hanging inside the box: a rusty key on a nail.

props.title: a sign on the stall
lines: 'TOOLS. LOCKED. Code from the plant, ask the robot.' Someone had a sense of humour.

props.locked_text: The back stall is shut with a heavy lock. It takes an old key.

title: Vex's Bunker
subtitle: the last working lights in the plant

done_lines: UNIT-7 SELF-TEST: PASSED. 'Thank you. My left wheel has felt wrong for 2,191 days.'

props.title: Unit-7's maintenance log
lines: UNIT-7 LOG, entry 4,410: Swept floor. Floor clean. Floor will be dirty again tomorrow.
Entry 4,411: Farmer requested barn padlock reset. New code: 2-2-0-8. (Shift change, 22:08.)
Entry 4,412: No one has come. Swept floor.

props.title: miners' rules
lines: RULE 1: Mind the dark. RULE 2: Never mine alone. RULE 3: What you dig up, you put to use.
Scratched underneath: 'rule 4: the wall at the far end of the east cut is hollow. don't tell Vex.'

done_lines: The old lift groans and the gallery lamps come up. Ore glints in every wall.

title: Ines's Lab
subtitle: she left the lights on for you

done_lines: Inside the vault: a blade that hums with stored sunlight, and a card in Ines's hand:
'For whoever closes the loops. Cut only what needs cutting.'
locked_lines: A vault with a four-digit dial. Ines would have told only one person the code.

done_lines: Evaporation, condensation, rain, runoff, the river, the sea. Round and round.

props.title: a letter
lines: 'Tobi. If you are reading this, you came back. I am not angry. I was never angry.'
'The vault code is the day we met. You will remember. You always remembered the important things.'
